papers.title: Which Voices Move Markets? Speaker Identity and the Cross-Section of Post-Earnings Returns
papers.authors: Karmanpartap Singh Sidhu, Junyi Fan, Maryam Pishgar
papers.one_line: Speaker-weighted FinBERT sentiment on earnings call transcripts achieves OOS IC 0.142 and monthly long-short alpha 2.03% (FF5, t=6.49) on S&P 500, with analysts (49%) and CFO (30%) as dominant signals.
papers.actionability: Directly upgrades R31 text-PEAD: weight FinBERT sentence scores by speaker role before aggregation. Analyst sentiment (49%) is the strongest predictor, not CEO prepared remarks.

papers.title: When Valid Signals Fail: Regime Boundaries Between LLM Features and RL Trading Policies
papers.one_line: LLM-derived features achieve IC 0.177-0.233 in stable markets but cause -8.88% return differential vs price-only baseline during tariff-driven volatility shock (H1 2025). Regime-gating of LLM features is mandatory.
papers.actionability: Add regime-gating kill switch: when VIX is elevated (>25), suppress LLM features and revert to pure statistical model. Validate R28/R29 LLM layers across H1 2025 tariff shock period explicitly.

papers.title: Regime-Aware Specialist Routing for Volatility Forecasting
papers.one_line: State-dependent specialist routing for ETF volatility forecasting reduces high-volatility forecast loss by 24% and underprediction loss by 22% vs rolling-best baseline, using online regime gating.
papers.actionability: Architecture reference for R35 regime-aware routing: use calm/stressed specialist switching rather than one-size-fits-all regime model. Relevant to R32 VIX-Kelly put-writing sizing adjustment.

papers.title: Portfolio Optimization Proxies under Label Scarcity and Regime Shifts via Bayesian and Deterministic Students under Semi-Supervised Sandwich Training
papers.one_line: Teacher-student (CVaR optimizer → neural models) on synthetically augmented data for label-scarce portfolio optimization. Not directly actionable for current rounds.
papers.actionability: Low priority — methodology could help if Kevin ever wants to optimize across fewer labeled strategy observations.

papers.title: Global Persistence, Local Residual Structure: Forecasting Heterogeneous Investment Panels
papers.one_line: Two-stage global AR(1) + block-specific local residuals improves panel R² from 0.630 to 0.677 on 93-actor investment panel. Theoretical but not directly actionable.
papers.actionability: Not actionable for current rounds. File for reference if future factor panel models are built.

papers.title: Testing Alpha in High-Dimensional Conditional Time-Varying Factor Models with Dependent Observations
papers.one_line: Develops B-spline sieve sum/max/Cauchy combination tests for alpha in high-dimensional time-varying factor models. Applied to S&P 500 weekly returns 2005-2024. Statistical methodology paper.
papers.actionability: Statistical tool for validating that backtest alpha is significant. Could be useful for R28/R29 final statistical validation. Low priority.
